acceptance_policy.board_gate: Require execution of the selected bitstream on the supplied VU9P board setup and board-valid output evidence. Use the supplied project for exact board and pass criteria; do not claim a board pass without evidence.
acceptance_policy.dse_gate: Measure the complete legal FPGA-effective candidate universe with real synthesis evidence. Select for highest end-to-end throughput among candidates within discovered resource and timing limits; do not select solely for minimum resource use. Keep estimates distinct from measurements.
acceptance_policy.functional_acceptance: Require valid nonzero output and no deadlock after full layer computation on the real board-accurate AXI/DDR system. Bit-exact numeric matching is not required by this task; do not invent a numeric tolerance.
acceptance_policy.promotion_gate: Promote only after all three verification layers pass. Any failed layer requires real-tool-output-based, CCTG/contract-guided localization, bounded repair, and rerun before promotion.
acceptance_policy.semantic_and_architecture_requirements: Preserve the supplied Gemma model facts, operator order, complete layer workload, numeric policy, memory layout, AXI/DDR behavior, and template architecture. No silent substitutions or changes.
acceptance_policy.tool_gates: Require real functional verification with VCS or Verilator and real Vivado synthesis, implementation, and bitstream-generation evidence. Skipped checks, fallback, dry-run, and smoke-only evidence do not pass.

design_goal: Complete board-runnable spatial accelerator for the supplied Gemma checkpoint and full decoder-block workload. Preserve the supplied model semantics and the established OPT-aligned schedule: W4A8 signed INT4 weights, INT8 activations, INT32 accumulation, integer DSP MACs, complete weights in external DDR, 512-bit DDR loading/refill, bounded active/shadow weight caches, next-layer/tile prefetch, activation ping-pong, ready/valid backpressure, token-level operator overlap, and the supplied VU9P board project's exact AXI/DDR wrapper and compute-slot behavior. Do not use floating-point IP in the elaborated W4A8 datapath. Run the complete real-tool Stage 0–7 workflow. Measure the complete legal FPGA-effective DSE candidate universe with synthesis evidence, then select for highest end-to-end throughput within discovered resource and timing limits; report analytical estimates separately from measured results.

notes: Preserve the supplied model facts: decoder block; hidden size 1152; 26 layers; sequence length 16; causal MQA with 4 query heads, 1 KV head, head dimension 256, and qk normalization; RoPE with theta 1000000 and local base frequency 10000; sliding window 512 and pattern 6; pre-RMSNorm with epsilon 1e-6 and no norm bias; gated MLP with intermediate size 6912 and gelu_pytorch_tanh; separate Q/K/V, dense output projection, gate_up_down MLP layout, and weight-only norms.

The supplied facts state that checkpoint tensor names and checkpoint contents are not present in the supplied model source evidence. Resolve them from actual checkpoint materials during the run; otherwise leave them unknown and report the limitation.
Do not change shared templates, numeric policy, board materials, or generic agent workflow. Do not substitute another model or fixed project dimensions.

Use real LLM calls and real tools for production evidence. Functional verification must use VCS or Verilator; synthesis, implementation, and bitstream generation must use Vivado. Fallback, dry-run, smoke-only, or checker-skipped evidence cannot promote the design.

Follow the required three-layer debug and promotion loop: operator/leaf modules; connected single-transformer-layer kernel; then the exact board AXI/DDR wrapped system with real DDR weight loading, active/shadow switching, prefetch, activation ping-pong, and final writeback. On a failure, use real tool output and CCTG/contract-guided localization, apply bounded repair, and rerun the failed layer before promotion.

Inspect the supplied board project for exact part, shell/runtime, AXI/DDR constraints, and pass criteria. Do not infer unspecified board or tool details. Report missing or conflicting inputs rather than inventing them.
